refined_passages.title: SKF Vibration Diagnostic Guide
refined_passages.text: Useful vibration interpretation depends on measurement location, sensor orientation, operating state, speed, load, and a comparable baseline. Spectral components may support a hypothesis only when the machine geometry and speed needed to calculate characteristic frequencies are known. Without those inputs, report the measured change and request the missing context rather than assigning a physical fault meaning to a peak.
